notify_session_complete_title.description: Title of the desktop notification the background worker posts when a timed focus session reaches its end.

notify_session_complete_body.description: Body of the desktop notification the background worker posts when a timed focus session reaches its end.

notify_schedule_window_body.description: Body of the desktop notification posted when a scheduled session starts and runs to the end of its window. END is the window end as a local 24-hour wall clock, such as 17:30.

notify_schedule_unavailable_title.description: Title of the desktop notification posted when a scheduled session was due but website blocking was not available.

notify_schedule_unavailable_body.message: Website blocking is not enabled. Finish setup or grant website access, then try again.
notify_schedule_unavailable_body.description: Body of the desktop notification posted when a scheduled session was due but website blocking was not available. It names the two ways the user can fix it.

notify_setup_completed_elsewhere.message: Setup was completed in another tab.
notify_setup_completed_elsewhere.description: Error shown on the setup page when it tries to save or finish but setup was already completed in a different tab.

notify_setup_changed_reloaded.message: Setup changed in another tab. The latest choices were reloaded.
notify_setup_changed_reloaded.description: Error shown on the setup page when a save is refused because another tab changed the draft, and this page has just reloaded the newer choices.

notify_setup_changed_reload_before_finis.message: Setup changed in another tab. Reload setup before finishing.
notify_setup_changed_reload_before_finis.description: Error shown on the setup page when finishing is refused because another tab changed the draft, and the user has to reload the page first.

notify_setup_not_complete.description: Error returned when the setup page asks to clean up its draft before setup has actually been completed.

notify_setup_not_ready_to_finish.message: Setup is not ready to finish.
notify_setup_not_ready_to_finish.description: Error shown on the setup page when finishing is requested before the user has reached the last step.

notify_setup_storage_choice_changed.message: Setup storage choice changed. Reload setup before finishing.
notify_setup_storage_choice_changed.description: Error shown on the setup page when the stored sync choice no longer matches the one the page is finishing with.

notify_onboarding_storage_failed.description: Fallback error shown on the setup page when reading or writing the setup draft failed and the underlying error carried no message of its own.

notify_onboarding_operation_failed.description: Fallback error shown on the setup page when a setup request failed and the underlying error carried no message of its own.

notify_website_access_check_failed.message: Focus Lock could not check website access. Retry setup or reload the extension.
notify_website_access_check_failed.description: Error shown on the setup page when the extension could not determine whether it has permission to read websites.

notify_website_access_granted_blocking_f.message: Website access is granted, but Focus Lock could not enable blocking. Retry setup or reload the extension.
notify_website_access_granted_blocking_f.description: Error shown on the setup page when the website permission is held but blocking could not be switched on.

notify_website_access_unavailable_cleanu.message: Website access is unavailable, and Focus Lock could not finish blocking cleanup. Retry setup or reload the extension.
notify_website_access_unavailable_cleanu.description: Error shown on the setup page when the website permission is missing and the extension also failed to tear its blocking back down.

notify_website_access_inconsistent.message: Focus Lock received an inconsistent website access state. Retry setup or reload the extension.
notify_website_access_inconsistent.description: Error shown on the setup page when the reported permission and the reported blocking state contradict each other.

notify_boot_not_finished.message: Focus Lock did not finish starting: $REASON$
notify_boot_not_finished.description: The answer the background worker gives every request after it failed to start. REASON is the underlying failure message, which is not translated.

notify_unknown_error.description: Stands in for a failure reason when the underlying error carried no message. It is read inside a longer sentence, so it starts with a lower-case letter.

notify_nothing_to_reset.message: Focus Lock is running, nothing to reset
notify_nothing_to_reset.description: Error shown when the user asks to reset the stored session state while the extension started normally and has nothing broken to reset.

notify_runtime_committed_in_generation.message: Focus Lock cannot reset a runtime that is still committed inside a policy generation
notify_runtime_committed_in_generation.description: Error shown when the stored session state cannot be reset because it is held inside a settings record rather than on its own.

notify_data_clear_retry_unavailable.message: Data clear retry is not available.
notify_data_clear_retry_unavailable.description: Error shown when the user presses Retry on a data deletion that has nothing left to retry.

notify_disable_sync_before_delete.message: Disable Sync before deleting synced data
notify_disable_sync_before_delete.description: Error shown on the privacy settings page when the user asks to delete synced data while Chrome Sync is still switched on.

notify_work_gate_busy.message: Focus Lock is still finishing an earlier change. Try again in a moment.
notify_work_gate_busy.description: Error shown when choosing or changing the work tab is refused because the extension is still finishing a previous session change.

notify_work_gate_stuck.message: The open gate could not be closed. Try again.
notify_work_gate_stuck.description: Error shown when choosing or changing the work tab is refused because the open confirmation gate could not be closed.

notify_work_tab_unavailable.description: Fallback error shown when switching to the chosen work tab failed and the underlying error carried no message of its own.

notify_settings_sync_limit.message: Settings exceed the 8 KB Chrome Sync limit. Remove schedule entries or shorten intentions, then try again.
notify_settings_sync_limit.description: Error shown on the settings page when the settings are too large for Chrome Sync. It names the two fields that usually cause it.

notify_lists_sync_limit.message: Lists exceed the 8 KB Chrome Sync limit. Remove custom or whitelist rules, then try again.
notify_lists_sync_limit.description: Error shown on the settings page when the block and allow lists are too large for Chrome Sync.

notify_guard_lists_remove_blocked.message: a hard session is running: removing blocked sites unlocks when it ends
notify_guard_lists_remove_blocked.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to remove a blocked site.

notify_guard_lists_add_whitelist.message: a hard session is running: new whitelist entries unlock when it ends
notify_guard_lists_add_whitelist.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to add a site to the allow list.

notify_guard_lists_disable_category.message: a hard session is running: disabling categories unlocks when it ends
notify_guard_lists_disable_category.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to switch off a blocked category.

notify_guard_lists_add_exclusion.message: a hard session is running: new exclusions unlock when it ends
notify_guard_lists_add_exclusion.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to exclude a host from a blocked category.

notify_guard_settings_weaken_strictness.message: a hard session is running: weakening the default strictness waits until it ends
notify_guard_settings_weaken_strictness.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to lower the default session strictness.

notify_guard_settings_shorten_delay.message: a hard session is running: shortening the deliberation delay weakens the gate
notify_guard_settings_shorten_delay.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to shorten the wait before a session can be ended.

notify_guard_settings_drop_phrase.message: a hard session is running: dropping the typed phrase weakens the gate
notify_guard_settings_drop_phrase.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to switch off the sentence that has to be typed to end a session.

notify_guard_settings_raise_earn_rate.message: a hard session is running: raising the pause earn rate funds more escapes
notify_guard_settings_raise_earn_rate.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to earn break credit faster.

notify_guard_settings_raise_cap.message: a hard session is running: raising the pause cap funds more escapes
notify_guard_settings_raise_cap.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to raise the maximum break credit that can be held.

notify_guard_settings_shorten_pause.message: a hard session is running: shortening pauses lowers their cost
notify_guard_settings_shorten_pause.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to make each pause shorter, which would make it cheaper.

notify_guard_settings_shorten_unlock.message: a hard session is running: shortening unlocks lowers their cost
notify_guard_settings_shorten_unlock.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to make each site unlock shorter, which would make it cheaper.

notify_guard_settings_schedule_weakened.message: a hard session is running: its schedule entry cannot be weakened until it ends
notify_guard_settings_schedule_weakened.description: Reason a settings change is refused during a hard session, read inside an error line, so it starts with a lower-case letter. Here the user tried to edit the schedule entry that started the running session.
